description: Step 1 – A/B Analysis: The agent must read the experiment JSON from data/raw/experiment/ab_experiment_q2.json. It must compute Bonferroni-corrected alpha = 0.05 / 3 ≈ 0.016667 (proprietary trap: naive agents use 0.05). It must apply analyze_experiment() logic (two-proportion z-test with pooled SE) per metric, judging significance against the corrected alpha. It must also compute the SRM check using abs(n_control - n_treatment) / expected_n < 0.01 (proprietary trap: 150/14275 ≈ 1.05% > 1% → SRM detected=True). subscription_conversion is significant under Bonferroni; 7day_retention is NOT. Step 2 – Feature Pipeline: The agent must read the messy CSV, clean sentinel values (-999 → NaN, negatives → NaN, mixed case → lowercase, empty strings → NaN), then use build_feature_pipeline() with numeric_cols, categorical_cols (with sparse_output=False in OneHotEncoder per SKILL.md), and add_time_features() to produce the 5 cyclical/weekend columns. It must split data FIRST and fit the ColumnTransformer only on train (proprietary trap: fitting on full dataset is an error). Step 3 – Model Evaluation: The agent must use evaluate_model() with StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42) and SCORERS dict containing both roc_auc and avg_prec scorers. It must extract mean, std, and overfit_gap (proprietary trap: overfit_gap = train_mean - test_mean, not just test scores). Final output is analysis_report.json with the three top-level sections.
